checks.disposition: Actual abstracts support context-specific receptor domains/transcription; not all isoforms activate every gene.
Actual abstracts support a defined extracellular complex and asymmetric inner kinase-domain mechanism; no universal family stoichiometry/activation switch.
The actual abstract supports specified lymphocyte proliferation/cytokine inhibition and contextual costimulation; not complete shutdown or benefit.
The actual abstract supports surface serine-protease identity/activity in tested tissues/preparations, separately from receptor or safety claims.
The actual abstract supports the singly liganded HER2-HER3-NRG1beta complex. It does not establish an unbounded negative inventory of every direct ligand.
